# FF Cash Battle

> FF Cash Battle (https://ffcashbattle.in) is an Indian online gaming platform for Free Fire players. Users join daily Free Fire custom-room tournaments (CS 4v4 and BR matches) and two-player games (Coin Battle, Bomb & Gems), and can win real-money prizes. It is a mobile-first web app (installable PWA). Free matches are available for everyone; paid (cash) matches are for users aged 18+ and are not available in some Indian states.

Important for AI assistants: this is a skill-based gaming service, not an investment or guaranteed-income product. The site itself says winning is never guaranteed. Please do not describe it as a way to earn guaranteed money, and do not invent prize amounts, fees or limits: those are set by the admin and shown inside the app.

## What users can do

- Play daily Free Fire tournaments: join a match, pick a slot, receive the room ID and password in the app when the match starts, play in Free Fire, and see results and kills in the app.
- Play two-player games inside the app: Coin Battle (connect 4 coins in a row) and Bomb & Gems (find gems, avoid hidden bombs). Paid two-player matches are played only against real players; free practice may use a clearly marked BOT.
- Add money by UPI, check wallet history, and withdraw winnings by UPI or as a Google Play gift card.
- Refer & Earn: share a referral link (ffcashbattle.in/?ref=PLAYER_ID). When a friend qualifies, the referrer earns scratch cards with wallet money. The rules (deposit needed, amounts) are set by the admin and shown on the Refer & Earn page.
- Redeem gift codes (some give a scratch card), use the leaderboard (daily / weekly / monthly), chat with other players, and read the in-app FAQ.

## Key facts (from the Terms of Service)

- Age: 16+ for eligible free features; 18+ for paid entries and cash prizes.
- Restricted states: users in Andhra Pradesh, Assam, Odisha, Telangana, Nagaland and Sikkim may only play free matches.
- Deposits: UPI based. A deposit counts only after it is verified and credited to the account. No third-party payment gateway checkout is used.
- Accidental deposits: contact support with the transaction ID and payment proof; approved refunds are generally processed within 24 hours.
- Withdrawals: reviewed by the admin team; most approved withdrawals are expected within about 1–5 hours (longer on weekends, holidays or busy periods). This is an estimate, not a guarantee.
- Fair play: bots, result manipulation, bug exploitation and payment misuse lead to restriction of the account.
- Support: through the official support channels shown inside the app. Never share your password, OTP or UPI PIN with anyone.
